notes: Rejected 2026-10-25: opened as the largest MORABO (Andrew: "choose the largest sofa / sectional / chaise that can fit"). It is the 5-seat corner and the chaise section as one article ("1 x Frame for corner sectional, 5-seat"; "1 x Chaise section frame"), and comes only in Grann/Bomstad leather (black, golden brown, gray-green), $3,149.00, "Not stocked at IKEA Long Island, NY". The staged U is the same footprint from its two parts in the Gunnared fabric Andrew linked, ikea-99318311 + ikea-09318315 ($2,449.00), which the planner draws as an L and a rectangle. Worth a look if the fabric's fixed cover matters: leather wipes clean and holds no dust mites (F-66). 4 stars (8).
